note: Frozen, hand-verified developer-Python contract. Widening supportedVersionRange requires re-verifying mypy/ruff/pytest against the new interpreter with recorded evidence, not editing this file in isolation.
rationale: Native verification host: Arch/CachyOS with pacman as the sole package manager; Python 3.14 is the only Python line available there (no pyenv/uv, no 3.9-3.13 package). mypy 2.3.1 on Python 3.14.7 analyzes the target-version="py39" Ruff/mypy configuration with no internal error, superseding an earlier mypy-2.1.0-era internal error recorded against this same configuration. The developer interpreter version is pinned narrowly to what was actually verified there.
